section_2.title: 2.2 Account Usage

section_2.content_3: If you discover that your account has been stolen or has security vulnerabilities, please notify us immediately, and we will take necessary measures.

chapter_1.title: I. Introduction
chapter_1.content_1: Welcome to this product. We understand the importance of personal information to you and will do our best to protect your personal information securely and reliably. This "Privacy Policy" explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information, as well as the relevant rights you enjoy.
chapter_1.content_2: By using this product, you agree to the contents described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to any content of this Privacy Policy, please stop using this product.

section_1.title: 2.1 Actively Collected Information
section_1.content_1_1: Username, password, and other account information provided during registration.
section_1.content_1_2: Personal information you voluntarily provide, such as nickname, avatar, etc.
section_1.content_2_1: Product usage records, including login time, operational behavior, etc.
section_1.content_2_2: Feature usage, such as usage frequency, preference settings, etc.

section_2.title: 2.2 Automatically Collected Information
section_2.content_1_1: Device model, operating system version, browser type, etc.
section_2.content_1_2: Device identifiers (such as IMEI, MAC address, etc.).
section_2.content_2_1: IP address, network service provider information.
section_2.content_2_2: Access date and time, access source, and other log information.

section_3.title: 2.3 Third-party Provided Information
section_3.content: With your authorization, we may obtain your relevant information from third-party partners, such as social platform account information, etc.

section_1.title: 3.1 Service Provision
section_1.content_1: Provide, maintain, and improve various functions and services of this product for you.
section_1.content_2: Process your registration, login, identity verification, and other requests.
section_1.content_3: Save your personalized settings and preferences.

section_2.title: 3.2 Security Assurance
section_2.content_1: Verify your identity to prevent security risks such as account theft and fraud.
section_2.content_2: Detect, prevent, and investigate fraudulent behavior, security vulnerabilities, and illegal activities.
section_2.content_3: Ensure the safe and stable operation of this product and related services.

section_3.title: 3.3 Product Optimization
section_3.content_1: Analyze product usage to optimize product features and user experience.
section_3.content_2: Conduct data statistical analysis to understand user needs and usage habits.
section_3.content_3: Develop new products, new features, or improve existing products and services.

section_4.title: 3.4 Communication
section_4.content_1: Send you service notifications, product updates, promotional activities, and other information.
section_4.content_2: Process your inquiries, complaints, suggestions, and other feedback.

section_1.title: 4.1 Data Storage
section_1.content_1: We store your personal information within China.
section_1.content_2: The data storage period is limited to the minimum period necessary to achieve the purposes stated in this Policy.
section_1.content_3: When the storage period expires, your personal information will be deleted or anonymized.

section_2.title: 4.2 Technical Protection
section_2.content_1: Use encryption technology to protect your personal information and prevent information leakage or tampering.
section_2.content_2: Use access control technology to restrict access to personal information.
section_2.content_3: Regularly conduct security assessments and vulnerability scans, and fix security issues in a timely manner.
section_2.content_4: Establish data backup and disaster recovery mechanisms to ensure data security.

section_3.title: 4.3 Management Protection
section_3.content_1: Formulate and implement strict information security management systems and operating procedures.
section_3.content_2: Provide security training and authorization management for employees who access personal information.
section_3.content_3: Establish an emergency response mechanism for personal information leakage.

section_4.title: 4.4 Information Sharing
section_4.subtitle: We will not share your personal information with third parties unless:
section_4.content_2: Required by laws and regulations or government authorities.
section_4.content_3: Necessary for performing the contract, such as entrusting third parties to provide specific services.
section_4.content_4: To safeguard our legitimate rights and interests, such as preventing fraud and illegal activities.

section_1.title: 5.1 Right to Access
section_1.content: You have the right to query the personal information we have collected and stored about you.

section_2.title: 5.2 Right to Correction
section_2.content: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete content in your personal information.

section_3.title: 5.3 Right to Deletion
section_3.content_1: In specific circumstances, you have the right to request deletion of your personal information.
section_3.content_2: After account deletion, your personal information will be deleted or anonymized.

section_4.title: 5.4 Right to Withdraw Consent
section_4.content: You have the right to withdraw consent to the processing of your personal information, but withdrawal does not affect lawful processing carried out before withdrawal.

section_5.title: 5.5 How to Exercise Rights
section_5.content: You can exercise the above rights through the functions provided by this product or by contacting us (such as customer service email, customer service phone, etc.). We will process and respond within 15 working days.

section_1.title: 6.1 Use of Cookies
section_1.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, such as saving login status and remembering your preference settings. You can manage or delete cookies through browser settings.

section_2.title: 6.2 Cookie Management
section_2.content: You can disable cookies through browser settings, but this may affect the normal use of some features of this product.

chapter_7.title: VII. Protection of Minors
chapter_7.content: This product is primarily intended for adult users. If you are a minor, please use this product under the guidance of a guardian. We will strengthen the protection of minors' personal information in accordance with the "Minor Protection Law of the People's Republic of China" and other laws and regulations.

chapter_8.title: VIII. Policy Updates
chapter_8.content: We may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time. The revised policy will be announced within this product. If you continue to use this product, it will be deemed that you agree to accept the revised policy.

chapter_9.title: IX. Contact Us
chapter_9.content: If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, or need to exercise relevant rights, please contact us through the customer service channels provided by this product.
